notes: The set coheres around one spine: the killing thirst of Psalm 22:15 (#1 hook, #3-5 the three named images) -> the cross where it was spoken (#6) held a thousand years from David (#7) -> the conviction irony that the Maker of every water thirsts with nothing in His hands (#8/#10) while He offers living water (#9) -> two NT-named OT water echoes (#11 the Rock = 1 Cor 10:4; #12 Isaiah 55:1/44:3 'come, every one that thirsteth') -> the thirst stilled (#13) -> the hero close where the living water is drawn from Christ's own pierced side (#14). The thread is mirrored at the centre (#8) and lands on the gospel-pivot, exactly as required. The descriptive-match guard holds across the set — no scene depicts the vinegar sponge, so nothing visually asserts the Psalm 69 fulfilment the narration deliberately avoids. jesus_variant is consistent set-wide. No palette or character conflict; the five crucifixion scenes are differentiated by framing and theological function rather than repeating. No structural failure.
